answer: A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The plume counter is kept in hollow and marble publishes each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1656 identities would post 4895 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
